title: Striktes Mandantenscoping auf jeder Route
description: As a security admin, I want a hard separation between organisations, so that no developer can ever see the prompts of another department.

acceptance_criteria.given: the acting user is a developer of organisation A which owns three prompts
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with exactly the three prompts of organisation A
and: no field of any other organisation is present in the response
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-005-tenant-isolation.feature: A listing returns only the prompts of the own organisation

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt with a known id exists in organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer of organisation A requests that prompt by id
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 404 and an empty body
and: neither the title nor the owner nor the scan status leaks
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-005-tenant-isolation.feature: Accessing a foreign prompt by id does not reveal its existence

acceptance_criteria.given: a distinctive term occurs only in prompts of organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer of organisation A searches for that term
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with an empty result list and total count 0
and: the response contains no suggestion, no facet and no hint that a foreign match exists
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-005-tenant-isolation.feature: A search never reveals foreign hits through counts or previews
